summary: A first playbook pings hosts with ansible.builtin.ping and prints Hello world with ansible.builtin.debug, run with `ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini playbook.yaml`, producing per-host ok results and a play recap.
questions: How do I write my first Ansible playbook?
How do I run a playbook against an inventory file?
How do I print a message in a playbook?

answer_card.title: Hello world playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: My first play
  hosts: myhosts
  tasks:
    - name: Ping my hosts
      ansible.builtin.ping:

    - name: Print message
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: Hello world
```
```bash
ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini playbook.yaml
```
